subject: Quick note on RMC Mechanical's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and RMC Mechanical stood out.

Wolverhampton heating and mechanical engineers on Steelhouse Lane - and rmcmechanical.co.uk still ships as HTML 4.01 Transitional in iso-8859-1, still embeds Dreamweaver template paths pointing at a local D: drive, still loads a Flash SWF banner, and still publishes Fax: 01902 871534 beside a btconnect address. Serious Black Country mechanical house; a front end frozen like an early-2000s brochure page with a live fax line.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
